text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My work laptop has been running poorly
as of
late, so I decide to buy a
replacement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look through a catalog for my options,
but my eyes glaze over when I see the
different models,
unable to make sense
of the technical jargon...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so that piece of junk finally broke
down?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The catalog seems to have piqued her
interest, and her eyes linger on its
pages. I take the opportunity to slide in
a question while she's
engaged.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No. And even if I did, I wouldn't give
you any.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I point to a fairly priced model, which is
proudly
labeled as a popular best seller.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Are you kiddin'? What do you need such
a
high-spec model for? It'd just be a
waste of
money.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You don't need a powerful CPU or a good
graphics card if all you're planning
to use it for is
recordkeeping and
drafting documents.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You should be lookin' for something that
won't strain your eyes. A simple,
lightweight model with an anti-glare
screen would be more up your
alley...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering how reticent she usually is,
it feels like a wonder how easily the
words tumble from
her mouth. I can't
help but stare at her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Tch, it's your laptop, so figure it out
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur looks more than ready to
leave. There
must be something I can say
to stop her!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You can't be serious right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, 'cause I'm only explainin' this
once.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Think of it as a computer's brain. How
smart that
brain is changes the price.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But knowin' the type of work you do,
there's no
need for anything with high
specs.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'd put that money into other things, if I
were you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that grin off your face. The hell's
wrong with
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But there's no such thing as a free lunch
in the
world.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you want me to tell you, you gotta do
somethin'
for me too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Buy this HDD for me. I've been wantin' a
new one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My eyes nearly pop out of their sockets
when I
see how much it costs!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now. what was it you wanted to know
the
definition of? "Anti-glare"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you got any other words you don't
know, I can
tell you. One term, one new
computer part for
me. Great deal, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Frankly, I don't think my wallet can
handle such pricey demands, but I've
kind of got my back to
the wall since I
said I'd do "anything."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Geez. I'm just kidding, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Man, you're so freakin' desperate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just meant its normal old weight. As in,
pick
something that doesn't physically
weigh much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hehe, dummy.
